ABOUT LEADERSHIP Flag Officer Biographies

Rear Admiral Morgan Ellis

Commander, Naval Sea Systems Command

Rear Adm. Morgan Q. Ellis is a native of Dayton, Ohio. He graduated from the United States Naval Academy in 1994.

His sea tours include duty aboard USS Example (DDG 999). He assumed command of Carrier Strike Group NINE in May 2019.

Ashore, he served as executive assistant to the Assistant Secretary of the Navy (Research, Development and Acquisition).

Ellis assumed duties as Commander, Naval Sea Systems Command in June 2024.
